objectives.title: Resolve a library id
objectives.why: Context7 maps a package name to the exact library it has docs for — always start here.

objectives.title: Fetch up-to-date library docs
objectives.why: Pull current docs into context so the model stops hallucinating stale APIs.

objectives.title: Teach your agent to reach for Context7
objectives.why: Adding 'use context7' to your rules makes fresh docs the default, not an afterthought.

bestPractices.title: Keep your Context7 API key out of git
bestPractices.why: The key raises your rate limits — and shouldn't be public.

bestPractices.title: Fetch docs before using an unfamiliar API
bestPractices.why: Grounding in real docs first is the whole point — it prevents plausible-but-wrong code.

criteria.rubric: Do the project rules instruct the agent to fetch current library docs via Context7 before writing code against unfamiliar or fast-moving libraries?

badges.name: House Rules
badges.description: Made Context7 a default in your rules.

badges.name: Key Keeper
badges.description: Kept your API key out of git.

badges.name: Always Current
badges.description: Grounds code in fresh docs by default.
